chunks: Who obstruct others from the way of God and seek obliquity in it, and do not believe in the life to come.
ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of those who seek obliquity in the path of God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual failure of the disbelievers: their active obstruction of others from divine guidance and their internal pursuit of deviation (i'waj) from the straight path. Their denial of the Hereafter serves as the root cause that justifies and perpetuates this active misguidance, linking their theological rejection to their practical behavior.
